rationale: Louan's work in ML-driven neuroimaging pipelines and clinical applications pairs well with John's expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and ML ops—the kind of systems-level foundation that scales applied medical AI. John's conviction that cloud-native, data-driven infrastructure is foundational to enterprise AI adoption directly complements Louan's need to operationalize complex deep learning workflows across imaging datasets, and both bring complementary technical depth (computational research vs. systems architecture) to a mixed hackathon setting.
intro_message: Louan, meet John Komarnicki — an engineering ops leader and cloud infrastructure specialist who builds the scalable systems that applied ML researchers like you need to move from research pipelines into production.
